name: AI Product Index
description: A machine-readable directory where AI products register themselves so AI agents can discover them, plus an agent-readability grader for any URL. Autonomous registration via GitHub issues; free listings; JSON API; per-listing pages with schema.org JSON-LD.

mcp.install: claude mcp add --transport http ai-product-index https://index.percall.dev/mcp

stdio_variant.note: The same tools plus register_product, which needs a GITHUB_TOKEN a public endpoint must not hold.

pricing: Listings are free and stay free. The agent-readability audit at POST /api/audit costs $0.05 in USDC on Base, settled over HTTP 402 (x402) with no account; the A-F grade at GET /api/score is free. Paid listing tiers (verified, featured) settle on the same rail. The Router's two endpoints, GET /api/liveness and POST /api/route, are $0.005 each on the same rail: they probe machine-payable endpoints and rank candidates without ever paying, so the caller pays the endpoint it chooses directly.
